page.content:
Physical award sent when a channel crosses subscriber milestones.

How YouTube Play Button connects

  • Faction: YouTube Partner Program — Play Buttons mark subscriber milestones in the Partner era.
  • Creator: Chad Hurley — Hurley's play-button mark became the physical award's silhouette.

What is YouTube Play Button?

The silver, gold, and later diamond Play Buttons are the trophy case of the Partner era — objects that made subscriber counts ceremonial.

Key threads lead to YouTube Partner Program and Chad Hurley.
